name: Mirrored Sin
source:
Zak is a good boy. He prays every day, always does his homework on time, and listens to his Father.  So why does he feel [i]wrong[/i]? Why does [i]his[/i] eyes beckon him to have these thoughts? It's filthy. [I]You're[/i] [b]FILTHY[/b]!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
扎克是个好孩子。他每天祈祷，总是按时做作业，并听天父的话。那么为什么他会觉得[i]wrong[/i]呢？为什么[i]his[/i]的眼神在召唤他产生这些想法？很脏。[I]你是[/i] [b]FILTHY[/b]！

[来自Itch.io]
